hints.title: Minute and Second Encodings
hints.text: There are at most two valid minute and second breakdowns: standard quotient and remainder, and borrowing one minute for sixty seconds.

hints.title: Validate Range Constraints
hints.text: Ensure that minutes and seconds both remain within the 0 to 99 range.

hints.title: Simulate Keypad Movement
hints.text: Compute the transition and press costs from the starting finger position for each formatted digit sequence.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(1) testing at most two candidates
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Only checking standard mm:ss ignores borrowing 60 seconds which can save digit presses.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Testing both candidates directly yields optimal cost in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Analyze both representations and strip leading zeros accurately.

solutions.approach: Python candidate generation and cost calculation.
C++ lambda evaluation of both candidates.
